game.label: A folder with your own dump of Cadence of Hyrule for Nintendo Switch: the base game 1.0.0 (NSP, XCI, NSZ or XCZ), the 1.5.0 update (NSP or NSZ) and your console's prod.keys.

prepare.label: Building the game from your files. This takes a few minutes and needs about 12 GB free.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Fullscreen fills your screen. Windowed uses Window size.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size of the game's window in Windowed mode.

settings.label: Frame pacing
settings.help: Low latency shows the newest frame without tearing. V-Sync waits for the screen. Immediate never waits and can tear.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: How the game's picture is fitted to your screen. FSR is sharper; Bilinear is softer.

settings.label: Picture shape
settings.help: Fit keeps the game's 16:9 picture and adds bars where the screen is another shape. Stretch fills the screen.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps textures sharp at shallow angles. Applies the next time the game starts.

settings.label: Button layout
settings.help: Which button is the Switch's A. Nintendo plays by position, Xbox by the letter on the button. Automatic follows the controller that is plugged in.

settings.label: Performance overlay
settings.help: The frame rate, or the full timing graph, in a corner of the game. F10 switches it in the game.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your save, its three earlier copies and the game's cache.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The logs of the last five starts, to attach to a bug report.
